status: isolated experimental challenger; not approved or promoted

inputs.source_dimensions: original native width and height; no rescaling before scoring

method.surface: adaptive quadtree rectangular SVG tessellation; local SSE-guided split queue; optional per-cell rank-1 linear gradient
method.edge_residual: Canny(80,160) over grayscale, one 3x3 dilation, source-derived RGB quantization, horizontal same-color run encoding

controlled_experiments: S00 known geometry surface-only and hybrid residual outputs
A01 surface-only budget sweep at 1000, 2500, 5000 and 9000 cells
metrics: Canny edge precision/recall/F1 within a dilated one-pixel band
fresh paired Inkscape render wall time
limitations: edge/foreground quality metrics are proxies and not semantic annotations
the residual layer uses source-derived edge locations and colors
pixel metrics do not measure semantic structure or professional editability
measurements are specific to this local environment and Inkscape build
